title: Concept: PostgreSQL connection or authentication error text disclosed in a response
description: A failed PostgreSQL authentication reports the role it tried, and a failed connection reports the host and port. Serving that text tells the caller both the account namespace and the network position of the database, so the next attempt can target a real account instead of guessing.
applicability: Responses generated by an application whose database driver is libpq or a wrapper around it.
risk: The caller learns a valid database role name and the database host, which turns a blind credential attempt into a targeted one.
